metaTitle: Declare a version of {slug} — OCI Evaluation methods
lead: A version carries three declarations: the threat model, the disclosure profile and the operational envelope. They are frozen once its review begins, so the review applies to exactly what you declare here.
startsFrom: The fields start from version {version}. Change what is different in this version.
notAllowedTitle: Only the method’s submitter can declare a version
notAllowed: This method was registered by someone else. Its submitter, or a platform operator, declares its versions.
signedOutTitle: Sign in to declare a version
signedOut: Declaring a version is open to the method’s submitter once signed in.
unavailable: Your permissions on this method could not be read just now. Reload the page to try again.
threatHint: Who might try to learn something they should not, what this version does about each of them, what it takes for granted, and what it makes no promise about.
outOfScopeHint: One per line. At least one: a threat model with nothing out of scope is refused.
disclosureHint: Who sees what during an evaluation, what the guarantee rests on, and whether a result reproduces.
keyGovernanceHint: Who holds the decryption keys or the attestation roots.
reproducibleMethodHint: Required when a result can be reproduced.
envelopeHint: The limits a submission must be designed to run within. Runtime and memory caps are enforced by the sandbox.
fidelityMeasuredLabel: The fidelity gap has been measured
fixFields: Some fields need attention. Each one says what is wrong.
conflict: Version {version} is already declared on this method. Choose another version number.
forbidden: The platform refused the declaration: only the method’s submitter, or a platform operator, can declare a version. Nothing was recorded; your entries are kept below.
gone: This method no longer exists. Nothing was recorded.
unreachable: The platform could not be reached. Nothing was recorded; try again.
failed: The version could not be declared (error {status}). Nothing was recorded; your entries are kept below.

field.observations: Name between 1 and 16 parties and what each observes.
field.capability: Say what this party can do.
field.assumptions: Give at least one assumption, one per line.
field.outOfScope: Name at least one thing out of scope, one per line.
field.keyGovernance: Say who holds the keys or attestation roots.
field.permittedOperations: Give at least one permitted operation, one per line.
field.arithmeticPrecision: Give the arithmetic precision, for example fp32.
field.maxRuntimeSec: A whole number of seconds, at most {max}.
field.maxMemoryMb: A whole number of MiB, at most {max}.
field.fidelityMeasuredOn: Say what it was measured on.
